name: Magda
description: Aged barbarian berserker and sworn servant of the death-goddess Hel; Blessed by Hel (she does not age), she guards Gardwen and the lost twins and fights with berserk fury despite her years.
narrative: An old barbarian warrior-woman and sworn servant of Hel, goddess of death, called from a farmer's life by prophetic dreams. Though aged, she fights with berserker fury and is Blessed by Hel -- she does not age naturally. She follows Hel's directive to protect Gardwen and the lost twins, swearing 'by Hel herself' to see the quest through. Curmudgeonly and blunt, with a deep distrust and fear of arcane magic.

equipment.name: Mail hauberk and coif (all locations)
equipment.notes: Swords of the Lake issue; AP 5

abilities: Blessed By Hel -- does not age naturally
Artful Dodger -- 1 extra action for parry/evade if ENC < 26
Eyes in the Back of Your Head -- if attacked from behind, a Formidable Perception check to turn (costs 1 Action Point)
Detect magic and illusions using Willpower
Berserk Rage: Damage Mod +1d2, weapon size +1 step, take only 1/2 damage, immune to serious wounds and fatigue
Berserk Rage: Endurance & Willpower rolls to stay fighting 1 grade easier; Brawn 1 grade easier; parry/evade 1 grade harder
Berserk Rage: lasts 14 rounds; at the end automatic 1 Fatigue level loss; cannot retreat and must always engage the enemy
extras.armor: Mail hauberk + coif (AP 5 all locations), kettle helm (head AP 6)

encumbrance.note: ENC 17 -- under the 26 threshold, Artful Dodger active

extras.source: Roll20 Classic Fantasy character sheet (And then the Dragons Came campaign)
extras.source_class: Berserker (Classic Fantasy class; maps to Fighter in CFI's four core classes)
